description: Concrete figures from company filings, bank reports, tax returns, government awards and official registers; each value carries the filing it came from and a citable URL. All currently valid, evidence-backed facts for one entity — each with source, filing reference (e.g. SEC accession number), period, retrieval time, license and a citable fact_url. Optionally filtered to one predicate such as 'revenue' or 'total_assets'. Use for 'what do we know about X' and for exact reported values with verifiable provenance. Without predicate/period it returns the LATEST VALUE PER PREDICATE (compact, saves tokens) plus how many older values exist; pass predicate=<name> for the full history of one metric (newest period first), period=2025Q4 for one period, or full=true for every current fact (up to 500). Read each value's period_start before quoting it. Every value also carries value_status (observed | derived | estimated | imputed): a value the publisher modelled or that FACTANKER computed is not a measurement. For a development over time ("how did X change from 2018 to 2022") get_timeseries fits better: it marks gap years explicitly, which this tool does not. The values are public records: facts carry no copyright. US federal records are public domain or CC0; other publishers (e.g. DL-DE-BY-2.0, CC BY 4.0) require naming the source - see usage.attribution per fact. Numbers may be quoted verbatim.

entity.description: name or ID. Examples: 'Apple Inc.', 'cik:320193', 'Brooklyn', 'Wake County, North Carolina'

full.description: optional: true returns every current fact (up to 500). Default without predicate/period: the latest value per predicate, to save tokens.

period.description: optional: only facts of one period - '2025' (year), '2025Q4' (quarter) or '2025-12-31' (date)

name: get_facts
title: Get facts for an entity
